Docs.summary: A closed reference to the hosted text agent that owns conversation handling for a voice agent. The hosted agent is resolved within the same project and must declare `voice_conversation_engine` version `1.0.0`. Voice Live connects through the dedicated voice-conversation-engine endpoint using the existing Bridge Protocol 1.0 wire semantics; the Bridge message version is independent of the container protocol version and the Hosted Agents API version `v1`. Declaring `invocations_ws` is optional and does not substitute for `voice_conversation_engine`.
